findings.title: Unfair risk transfer – Baustelleneinrichtung
findings.message: The position states that the contractor must fully set up and maintain the site, but the contract remarks declare that the entire ground risk is borne by the contractor. This constitutes an unfair risk transfer that may be void under §307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Insert a clause limiting the contractor’s liability to the extent of normal site preparation and exclude ground‑risk responsibilities.

findings.title: Missing technical specification – Bodenprofil
findings.message: The description lacks the required specification of the homogeneous area (Homogenbereich) and the exact excavation depth per DIN 18300. This omission violates VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18300.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Boden gemäß Homogenbereich [B1] nach Geotechnischem Bericht, Aushubtiefe bis 3,00 m, seitlich lagern.’

findings.title: Missing disposal details – Bodenmaterial
findings.message: The long text does not specify the type of waste, the disposal facility, or the transport distance, which are mandatory under VOB/C §4.2 and the waste management regulations.
findings.suggestion: Include: ‘Nicht wiederverwendbares Bodenmaterial zur zugelassenen Deponie [Name] transportieren, Entfernung [km]’

findings.title: Missing frost protection details
findings.message: The specification does not state the frost protection class, material type, or installation method, contrary to VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18195.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Frostschutzmaterial Klasse 3, Typ XPS, 10 cm dick, nach DIN 18195 verlegen’

findings.title: Missing connection details – PE-HD Rohr
findings.message: The description omits the required connection type, joint material, and pressure class as per DIN 1936.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Verbindungsteile aus PE‑HD, Druckklasse 1, 150 mm DN, nach DIN 1936’

findings.title: Missing concrete class and reinforcement details – Schacht
findings.message: The long text lacks the concrete class, reinforcement specification, and curing conditions, violating VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 1045.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Betonfertigteile Klasse C25/30, Bewehrung Ø10 mm, 4 St, nach DIN 1045’

findings.title: Missing concrete details – Beton C25/30
findings.message: The specification does not mention the concrete mix design, slump, or curing regime required by DIN EN 206 and DIN 1045.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Beton C25/30, Schüttung 5 cm, 28‑Tage-Festigkeit, nach DIN EN 206’

findings.title: Missing masonry class – Mauerwerk KS 17,5 cm
findings.message: The description omits the required masonry class, load class, and reinforcement details per VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Kalksandstein KS 17,5 cm, Klasse 3, Bewehrung Ø8 mm, nach DIN 18331’

findings.title: Missing plaster details – Innenputz
findings.message: The specification lacks the plaster type, layer thickness, and curing conditions required by VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Innenputz, einlagig, 10 mm, Zement‑Kalk‑Mörtel, nach DIN 18331’

findings.title: Missing cement screed details – Zementestrich CT-C25-F4
findings.message: The description does not specify the screed thickness, reinforcement, or curing regime, contrary to VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Zementestrich CT‑C25‑F4, 20 mm, mit Bewehrung Ø6 mm, nach DIN 18331’

findings.title: Missing insulation details – Wärmedämmung Boden
findings.message: The specification lacks the insulation material, thickness, and thermal conductivity, violating VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Wärmedämmplatten XPS, d=100 mm, WLS 035, druckbelastbar 300 kN/m², nach DIN 18331’

findings.title: Missing waterproofing details – Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile
findings.message: The description omits the waterproofing material, water‑influence class, and installation method, violating VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18533.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile mit PMBC, Wassereinwirkungsklasse W1.2‑E, Trockenschichtdicke 3 mm, nach DIN 18533’

findings.title: Missing paving details – Pflasterdecke
findings.message: The specification does not state the paving material, joint width, or curing conditions required by VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Betonpflaster, 20 mm, 5 mm Joints, nach DIN 18331’

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer details – Asphalttragschicht
findings.message: The description lacks the asphalt binder type, layer thickness, and compaction parameters, violating VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18195.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Asphalttragschicht, 50 mm, Binder 4, Verdichtung 3‑Pass, nach DIN 18195’

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer details – Asphaltdeckschicht
findings.message: The specification does not specify the asphalt binder, layer thickness, or compaction method, contrary to VOB/C §4.2 and DIN 18195.
findings.suggestion: Add: ‘Asphaltdeckschicht, 30 mm, Binder 4, Verdichtung 3‑Pass, nach DIN 18195’
